patterns.statement: This map avoided commit/stop-say events and relied on character-count estimation for timing; speech-UI desync occurred in playtest.
patterns.condition: Game state or UI timing must stay synchronized with NPC speech
patterns.action: Subscribe to the persona component's commit-say and stop-say events; apply all pending state changes at the stop-say checkpoint so they follow the spoken line

patterns.statement: Required=true guarantees emission on every response, not only relevant turns; spurious payloads are expected and must be discarded.
patterns.condition: RegisterAction Required parameter is set to true to force model emission
patterns.action: Accept that Required=true forces output on every response including non-relevant turns; use a state-machine to filter spurious payloads

patterns.statement: This map tried character-count estimation and experienced UI desync with speech; measuring actual latency (3-40s range) was required.
patterns.condition: Speech duration is estimated from character count to start answer timers
patterns.action: Discard the estimate and measure real latency via logging instead; character-based estimation causes timer desynchronization with actual speech end
